title: Make Aggregator Introduction a Project Demonstrator Welcome
description: Rework the Entwerfen mit Bestand Aggregator's introduction tour so it opens with a proper welcome to the research project demonstrator, states clearly that this is an early prototype with incomplete/placeholder features, and acknowledges the three funding institutions (BMWSB, BBSR, Zukunft Bau) with the same logos used in the Zwischenbericht — before continuing into the existing app-tour steps (viewport, move-utility, catalogue, add-object). Requires extending the Rust IntroductionStepDefinition contract with an optional logos field (typegen'd to TS), rendering logos + multi-paragraph bodies in UIIntroduction (ui/js/react/index.tsx), copying the funding PNG assets into ui/asset/logo/, and rewriting framework/product/os/dev/brand/entwerfen-mit-bestand.brand.ts's introduction steps.
summary: Reworked the Entwerfen mit Bestand Aggregator's introduction to open with three project-demonstrator steps (welcome to the "Entwerfen mit Bestand" research project / LUH + UdK, early-prototype notice, and the Zwischenbericht's Förderhinweis with BMWSB/BBSR/Zukunft Bau funding logos) before the existing four app-tour steps. Extended the Rust IntroductionStepDefinition contract with an optional `logos: Vec<IntroductionLogo>` field (typegen'd to TS), added a new IntroductionLogoRow component in UIIntroduction that computes each logo row's shared height from the row's measured width and each logo's own natural aspect ratio (no guessed constants, no distortion, full-width fill), and copied the six funding-logo PNGs (light/dark) from the Zwischenbericht into ui/asset/logo. Verified via cargo check, framework-core:check (generated bindings match), the framework-renderer-react test suite (192/192 passing, including a new test asserting step order and logo hrefs/srcs), and an extensive live dev-server walkthrough (network 200s on all six logos, dark-mode variants, computed heights matching hand calculations, no console errors). The ui-react vitest suite could not be run to completion in this session — it crashed at the infrastructure/worker level on four separate attempts, unrelated to these changes (reproducible even before code edits, consistent with heavy concurrent memory load in this sandbox); the added UIIntroduction unit test is left in index.tsx for whenever that suite can run.
